court_crossing_strategy.basketball: Fixed hoop view only. Draw rear hoop/backboard first, then ball, then exact front-rim/net foreground asset while ball is in hoop mouth or behind near rim. Once ball clears bottom of net, draw it in front. Requires hoop foreground mask/layer; never approximate with a generic opaque rectangle. If not provided, do not claim behind-rim occlusion implemented.
court_crossing_strategy.volleyball: Fixed net plane only. Far-court actors/balls are drawn before net; near-court actors/balls after net. For an above-net crossing, render ball above net visually, change depth order only when ball crosses court plane, not merely screen y. Nets need real alpha openings.
court_crossing_strategy.scope: These are art-side draw-order requirements only, not implemented collision or runtime code.
